### Observation-Conditioned Rollout Allocation for Sampling Model Predictive Control on Myopic Egocentric Elevation Maps

**IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)**

Observation-conditioned sampling for real-time predictive navigation using limited egocentric 2.5D terrain information. Evaluated in simulation and on a real unmanned ground vehicle.
